newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Malaysia Titan Petrochemical's operational upset.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Titan Petrochemical's operational upset.

text.p: A petrochemical plant at Malaysia's Titan Petrochemical (M) Sdn Bhd, a unit of Taiwan's Titan Group, suffered "operational upset" in its system causing a flare-up, a company safety official said late Wednesday.
"Only the flare is a bit high," said the official. "There is nothing to worry about."
Another official said there was a "blow-up of gas" which causes the flare and emitted a lot of smoke.
The official said the plant located in Pasir Gudang in the southern Johor state was largely unaffected by the flare-up in spite of clouds of smoke spotted across the border in Northeast Singapore.
The Titan Petrochemical complex has three plants - Titan Petrochemical, Titan Polyethylene and Titan Himont Polymers.
